title: Buyer Eval. An AI analyst for buying B2B software.
terminal: Name the vendors you're considering, and what matters to you. It frames your criteria, checks for vendor AI agents, collects every material claim, and tests each one against the evidence.
found: Minutes later, you see what it found: what's verified, what's qualified, what's contradicted, and what nobody could answer.
claims: The centerpiece is claims versus evidence. Every claim shows where it came from, and what supports it. Here, the vendor's own AI agent promised a six-week rollout. Two customer accounts describe four to six months.
neutral: Vendor agents are sources, not judges. Having one never improves a vendor's score.
unanswered: It tells you what's still unknown, why it matters, what was checked, and who should answer.
demo: And it gives you the questions to ask in your next demo, with what to listen for.
brief: Everything lands in one Decision Brief you can forward to your CFO, your security team, and your VP.
end: Buyer Eval. Free and open source. Know what's true before you buy.
